description: Never Ending Interview cliffhanger (16:9): "SUBSCRIBE to find out if the question goes to NEXT and if they will answer…" right-aligned top right over a darkened still or black, optionally the open question quoted below. Glitch-in 0.3 s, glitch-out 0.2 s, 4–6 s, opaque H.264.

parameters.next: Name of the band the question goes to (drawn in capitals, up to 28 characters); without: "to find out who answers the next question…"
parameters.question: Optional open question (up to 100 characters), drawn quoted below
parameters.image: Optional still { sourceId | extensionId, in, crop? }, darkened behind the text
